phase_title: Phase 17 完了証跡の受領・整合確認

procedure_4_state_consistency_verificati.step_3_verify_production_status_hardcode: Verify production_status=NO_GO in all 9 with hardcoded comment indicating it never changes

procedure_5_phase_dependency_consistency.step_1_trace_dependency_chain: From each artifact, extract phase_dependencies.depends_on and phase_dependencies.feeds_into

procedure_6_implementation_purity_verifi.step_3_verify_app_unchanged: Confirm generic_block_ai/app/ has NO NEW files from Phase 17 (may have pre-existing M files from prior phases)
procedure_6_implementation_purity_verifi.step_4_verify_tests_unchanged: Confirm generic_block_ai/tests/ has NO NEW files from Phase 17 (may have pre-existing M files from prior phases)
